shots.text: A storm hit the island at *midnight*.
shots.place: a rocky island with a tall lighthouse, huge waves and black storm clouds
shots.action: stands holding his cap against the wind

shots.props: the lamp room of a lighthouse, the big lamp dark, glass cracked

shots.text: One ship was still at sea.
shots.place: stormy sea with a small wooden ship tossed by giant waves, lightning in the sky

shots.text: The old keeper ran for the stairs.
shots.place: inside a spiral stone staircase in the lighthouse
shots.action: runs up the stairs, panicked face

shots.props: a big white number 900 above a tiny staircase icon

shots.text: A doctor was sleeping in the village.
shots.place: a small village house at night with a lit window, rain falling
shots.action: wakes up and looks out of the window

shots.text: She saw the dark tower and *understood*.
shots.action: wide eyes, hand on her mouth

shots.place: muddy village road in a storm leading to a lighthouse on a cliff
top of the lighthouse in the dark lamp room
shots.action: they hold a lantern together and look at the sea

shots.props: a hand lighting the big lighthouse lamp, bright yellow glow

shots.text: The beam swept across the waves.
shots.place: stormy sea at night with a lighthouse beam cutting through the rain towards a small ship
sunrise over a calm harbour with a small fishing ship at the dock and a lighthouse behind
